basics.name: Christoforos Kagias
basics.summary: Electrical and Computer Engineer with professional experience in electronic systems development, hardware requirements engineering, and embedded software testing. Experienced in automotive industry projects and research and development activities for space applications, including electronic circuit design, electrical simulations, component selection, technical documentation, and hardware testing. Skilled in Altium Designer, LTspice, C, Python, and electronic design and testing tools.

work.summary: Contributing to the development of electronic systems for space applications.

Researching and selecting electronic components, including MCUs, gate drivers, relays, GaN FETs, and ADCs.
Researching and procuring equipment for electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) testing in accordance with ECSS-E-ST-20-07.
Participating in product architecture definition and schematic design using Altium.
